# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 58 (Bu-Vb Sk58)

**ID:** Bu-Vb Sk58  
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)  
**Collection:** Vinaya  
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 58  
**Title (English, from literature):** Holding a staff  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul2.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul2.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Daṇḍapāṇi* Sikkhāpada is the fifty-eighth training rule in the Sekhiya chapter of the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga, situated within the Vinaya Piṭaka. Translated by Bhikkhu Brahmali as "Holding a staff", the rule forms part of the Vinaya's pedagogical deportment regulations concerning not teaching Dhamma to individuals carrying a staff.

No secondary literature passages in the supplied dossier discuss this Vinaya text; search hits for "sk 58" correspond instead to verse 58 of the *Sāṅkhyakārikā* or Tibetan accounts of the Mahāsiddhas.

 Within the Pali tradition, it corresponds directly to Bhikkhu Pātimokkha Sekhiya 58, Bhikkhu Parivāra Sekhiya 58, Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 58, Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha Sekhiya 58, and the Bhikkhunī Parivāra. Parallel training rules survive in Sanskrit, Chinese, and Tibetan recensions across the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Dharmaguptaka, Mahāsaṅghika, Lokottaravāda, and Kāśyapīya lineages.
